# Experience Perth Hills

> A comprehensive tourism guide for the Perth Hills region featuring trails, activities, events, dining, and accommodation across multiple destinations.

Experience Perth Hills is the official tourism portal for the Perth Hills region in Western Australia, offering visitors curated directories of outdoor activities, cultural attractions, seasonal events, and hospitality options across destinations including Armadale, Kalamunda, Mundaring, Gidgegannup, and Serpentine Jarrahdale. The site serves as a central resource for trip planning, local discovery, and regional tourism information.

## Key Topics

- Perth Hills
- Armadale
- Kalamunda
- Mundaring
- Gidgegannup
- Serpentine Jarrahdale
- Outdoor activities
- Trails and hiking
- Wine and dining
- Events and festivals
- Accommodation
- Destination guides
- Darling Scarp
- Araluen Botanic Park
- Regional tourism

## Core Directories

- [Find Things To Do](https://experienceperthhills.com.au/find-things-to-do): Directory of Perth Hills activities including arts, outdoor recreation, culture and attractions
- [Trails](https://experienceperthhills.com.au/trails): Searchable directory of Perth Hills trails by destination, type and difficulty level
- [Find Wine & Dine](https://experienceperthhills.com.au/find-wine-and-dine): Directory of Perth Hills dining venues including wineries, breweries, cafes and restaurants
- [Find Events](https://experienceperthhills.com.au/find-events): Searchable events calendar for Perth Hills with filters by destination, date and organiser
- [Find Places to Stay](https://experienceperthhills.com.au/find-places-to-stay): Accommodation search for Perth Hills including camping, cottages, hotels and resorts

## Destination Guides

- [Destinations Overview](https://experienceperthhills.com.au/destinations): Overview of Perth Hills region with scenic attractions, dining and outdoor activities
- [Armadale](https://experienceperthhills.com.au/armadale): Destination guide for Armadale featuring art, culture, nature walks and local attractions
- [Kalamunda](https://experienceperthhills.com.au/kalamunda): Destination guide for Kalamunda featuring Lesmurdie Falls, markets, wineries and art galleries
- [Mundaring](https://experienceperthhills.com.au/mundaring): Destination guide for Mundaring with forests, national parks, art and historical attractions
- [Gidgegannup](https://experienceperthhills.com.au/gidgegannup): Destination guide for Gidgegannup with indigenous heritage, nature reserves and farm experiences
- [Serpentine Jarrahdale](https://experienceperthhills.com.au/serpentine-jarrahdale): Destination guide for Serpentine Jarrahdale on Darling Scarp with rural attractions

## Trip Planning & Resources

- [Plan Your Trip](https://experienceperthhills.com.au/find-plan-your-trip): Trip planning guide with itineraries, accommodation booking and visitor centre information
- [Visitor Centres](https://experienceperthhills.com.au/visitor-centres): Information about Perth Hills visitor centres and community resource centres

## Seasonal Guides

- [Spring](https://experienceperthhills.com.au/promote/spring): Seasonal guide for spring activities, events and wildflower viewing in Perth Hills
- [Autumn](https://experienceperthhills.com.au/promote/autumn): Seasonal guide for autumn activities and leaf-viewing locations in Perth Hills

## Inspiration & Stories

- [Blog](https://experienceperthhills.com.au/blog): Blog featuring Perth Hills travel inspiration, day trips and local experiences
- [I'm a Foodie: A Day Out in Perth Hills Armadale](https://experienceperthhills.com.au/im-a-foodie-a-day-out-in-perth-hills-armadale): Foodie itinerary for Armadale featuring local produce, cafes and award-winning restaurants

## Home

- [Home - Experience Perth Hills](https://experienceperthhills.com.au): Homepage introducing Perth Hills tourism with trails, activities, events, dining and accommodation
